question: Are the aircraft damage multipliers 4, 5 and 10 of L3318 stored in the level material grid?

sourceFacts.method: The projectile object of each mobile anti-air ammunition file stores a material value whose top 12 bits are the material ID (rule checked in L3321). Field_674633de was listed for those source materials against every target 0 to 799 in the Abbasid grid; the six targets with values above 1.25 shared by both materials were then reread with offset checks in the Abbasid and Badlands grids.

control.description: Same reader and material rule as L3321, whose controls (RPG 2, C4 3.5) passed; values equal across the two grids.

rawCheckSummary.tool: scripts/frosty-raw-check.py (material values: aa-raw-checks.json; grid reads: aa-grid-rawchecks.json)

inference: Half of each multiplier is stored in the grid. High velocity ammunition reads 2 against two targets and 2.5 against four, the same 4 to 5 ratio as EA's helicopter 52 and jet 65. Armour piercing and general purpose ammunition read 5 against all six, matching EA's single aircraft number for each.

In all four cases EA's number is exactly twice registry StartDamage times the grid value (26, 32.5, 100 and 65 against 52, 65, 200 and 130). The remaining factor 2 is not traced. Every cell also stores Field_7fa53094 = 2, but the mine cells of L3321 store the same 2 and need no extra factor, so it is not shown to be the cause.
Which targets are helicopters and which are jets is inferred from EA's numbers only: 121 and 669 would be helicopters, 120, 207, 233 and 670 jets.
unresolved: The remaining factor 2. Test: one high velocity rocket hit on a full-health helicopter; 52 confirms twice the product, 26 would mean EA counts two hits or a pair.
Target identities are not named in stored data. Test: the same single hit on a transport helicopter, an attack helicopter and a jet; readings of 52, 52 and 65 would confirm the split.
The mine explosion material reads 11 against the same six targets. Test: land a helicopter on an M15 mine; 195 x 11 would destroy any aircraft outright.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Anti-air damage against aircraft: the material grid stores half of each multiplier
leads.summary: For mobile anti-air ammunition the grid's Field_674633de reads 2 and 2.5 (high velocity) and 5 (armour piercing, general purpose) against six aircraft targets. EA's numbers are exactly twice registry StartDamage times these values, with the helicopter to jet ratio 4 to 5 reproduced. The remaining factor 2 is not traced. 629 raw reads matched.
leads.reopenWhen: A current-build single-hit damage reading on a helicopter or jet, or a stored field shown to carry the remaining factor 2.
leads.statusNote: Ratio and three official numbers reproduced up to an untraced factor 2; target identities inferred; joins by name.
